name: D&O
recent: D&O 近期公告主要涉及大股东 Goh Nan Kioh 的持股变动，以及 KWAP 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日不再是大股东。公司最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比增长 2.6%，但同比减少 5.2%，并录得净亏损 2564 万令吉。
notable: 大股东 Goh Nan Kioh 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次申报持股变动。
KWAP 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日申报不再是大股东。
risks: 大股东 Goh Nan Kioh 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次申报持股变动。
KWAP 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日申报不再是大股东。
最新季度净亏损 2564 万令吉，净利率为 -11.1%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 2.3146 亿令吉，环比增长 2.6%，同比减少 5.2%；净亏损 2564 万令吉，净利率 -11.1%，较上一季度的 -26.0% 有所收窄，但净亏损同比扩大 3821.8%。

recent_en: D&O's recent announcements mainly involve changes in substantial shareholder Goh Nan Kioh's holdings, and KWAP ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 14 September 2026. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 2.6% qoq but fell 5.2% yoy, with a net loss of MYR 25.64 million.
notable_en: Substantial shareholder Goh Nan Kioh filed multiple changes in holdings between September and October 2026.
KWAP filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 14 September 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Goh Nan Kioh filed multiple changes in holdings between September and October 2026.
KWAP filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 14 September 2026.
Latest quarter recorded a net loss of MYR 25.64 million, with a net margin of -11.1%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 231.46 million, up 2.6% qoq but down 5.2% yoy; net loss was MYR 25.64 million with a net margin of -11.1%, narrower than -26.0% in the prior quarter, while net loss widened 3821.8% yoy.
